integrity: All all-parameter conclusions are proved algebraically. Exhaustive computation is used only as an standalone finite check at the smallest Theorem 3.5 size, not as evidence for an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The result identifies a norm-fiber model, a guaranteed cyclic automorphism subgroup, and a permutation-equivalence collapse for the rank-one regime. It does not determine the full automorphism group or classify equivalence among all rank-two constraint subspaces.
title: Relative-trace collapse of a Gold defining-set code family
